= named-index(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:acdc-index:
:experimental:

== Name
named-index - keep complete macros in index labels

== Synopsis

[[target]]
Destination.

N01 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/url[Link] after] end.

N02 indexterm2:[Before link:https://example.org/link[Link] after] end.

N03 indexterm2:[Before mailto:user@example.org[Mail] after] end.

N04 indexterm2:[Before xref:target[Target] after] end.

N05 indexterm2:[Before footnote:one[Only note.] after] end. Reuse footnote:one[].

N06 indexterm2:[Before [literal] after] end.

N07 indexterm2:[Before [literal\] after] end.

N08 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/incomplete[Link] end.

N09 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/escaped[Link\] after] end.

N10 indexterm2:[Before \https://example.org/inactive[Link] after] end.

N11 indexterm:[Category,"https://example.org/comma[Link, label]",Tail] end.

N12 indexterm2:[Before anchor:inner[Ref] after] end. See <<inner,Inner>>.

N13 indexterm2:[Before btn:[Save] after] end.

N14 indexterm2:[Before kbd:[Ctrl+C] after] end.

N15 indexterm2:[Before menu:File[Open > Recent] after] end.

N16 indexterm2:[Before <<target,Target] text>> after] end.

N17 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/format[*Bold*] after] end.

N18 indexterm2:[Before https://outer.example[Outer mailto:inner@example.org[Inner] tail] after] end.

N19 indexterm2:[Before indexterm2:[Nested] after] end.

N20 indexterm2:[Before footnote:one[] after] end.

N21 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/unicode[café] after] end.

N22 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/bracket[Bracket\] label] after] end.

N23 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/multiline[Multiline
label] after] end.

N24 indexterm2:[Before https://one.example[One] and https://two.example[Two] after] end.

N25 indexterm2:[Before pass:q[*Protected*] after] end.

N26 indexterm:[Category,https://example.org/unquoted[Link, label],Tail] end.

N27 \indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/outer-escape[Link] after] end.

N28 indexterm2:[Before unknown:[Literal] after] end.

N29 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/quoted["Label, comma",role=term] after] end.

N30 indexterm2:[First https://example.org/adjacent[Link]]indexterm2:[Second].
